Q: pnpm audit responded with 410: {"error":"This endpoint is being retired. Use the bulk advisory endpoint instead.} A:

I chose to migrate the PNPM version from 10.33.0 to 11.0.0-rc.1. In version 11.0.0-rc.1, pnpm audit now uses npm’s /-/npm/v1/security/advisories/bulk endpoint. The legacy /-/npm/v1/security/audits{,/quick} endpoints have been retired by the registry, so the legacy request/response contract is no longer supported.

https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/tree/v11.0.0-rc.1
